_readme: One entry per shelf you want a 3D room for.
match    - shelf name exactly as it appears in the library
model    - path to a .gltf or .glb ON YOUR OWN SD CARD
source   - where you got the model; shown as attribution
credit   - author and licence, shown in the room
camera   - yaw and pitch in radians, distance, and a target point
VITRINE downloads no models. Most published models are not
licensed for redistribution, so supply your own file and keep
